post.caption: Lewis and Clark's necklace was misfiled. It is a Native American necklace of 38 grizzly bear claws that Lewis and Clark brought home. A descendant gave it to Harvard's Peabody Museum in 1941, and someone catalogued it as Pacific Islands material. It sat among the Pacific objects for more than 60 years. In 2003, two assistants inventorying the storeroom spotted the mistake. An old label said it was presented by Lewis and Clark. The Peabody announced the find in January 2004 and put it in its Lewis and Clark exhibition in May.
